title: Do not authorize unrelated operational work through inauguration
summary: Do not interpret MVP inauguration as permission to alter unrelated repositories, system services, startup behavior or deployments outside the approved scope.
statement: Do not interpret MVP inauguration as permission to alter unrelated repositories, system services, startup behavior or deployments outside the approved scope.

conditions: A user-authorized MVP review, inauguration or post-MVP maintenance operation is taking place.
exceptions: No implicit authorization to publish tags, releases or deployments.
